Functions representing a state transition feature and/or features of an output state for an input sequence, used to compute conditional probability.

US7756837B2
A patent document titled "Methods and apparatus for searching backup data based on content and attributes" that discloses transparent bridging of backup storage devices and extraction of management data from backup data-streams.

Backup Storage Device
A device on which data-streams are archived and to which data-streams are passed before, during, or after extraction.<SEP>A storage device intended for archiving data-streams; an intermediate device transparently imitates such a device so that backup software sends its data-stream to it as part of the standard backup process.<SEP>A device on which the data-stream is intended to be archived and to which the data-stream is delivered.<SEP>A device intended to store and archive data-streams, to which data-streams are delivered transparently.

Backup Software
Software that produces backup data-streams and sends them to a storage device, identifying an intermediate device as a standard backup storage device.

Data-Stream
A stream of data intended for archiving on a backup storage device, from which management data is extracted.<SEP>A stream of data intended for archiving on a backup storage device, from which management data is extracted and which is also stored on the backup storage device.<SEP>A stream of data received from one or more sources and intended for archiving on a backup storage device; management data is extracted from it.

Management Data
Data extracted from a data-stream, including source identifier, volume information, metadata, data file type information, and keywords.<SEP>Data extracted from a data-stream describing its contents, including source identifiers, volume information, metadata, data file types, and keywords; stored in a searchable format in a database.<SEP>Data extracted from the data-stream, including source identifier, volume information, metadata, data file type information, and keywords of the data files.<SEP>Data extracted from a data-stream including source identifier, volume information, metadata, data file types, and keywords.

Intermediate Device
A device that is transparent to the source producing the data-stream, appearing to the source as a backup storage device while extracting and storing management data.

Source
The source producing the data-stream, which may be a computer server, desktop computer, laptop computer, notebook computer, personal digital assistant, or source database.<SEP>The origin producing the data-stream, which may be a computer server, desktop computer, laptop computer, notebook computer, personal digital assistant, or source database.<SEP>An entity producing the data-stream, to which the receiving, extracting, and storing actions are transparent such that it is apparent the data-stream is being delivered to a backup storage device.<SEP>The producer of a data-stream, which may be a computer server, desktop computer, laptop computer, notebook computer, personal digital assistant, or source database.

Volume
A storage volume such as a computer disk drive or computer sub-drive, concerning which volume information is included in management data.<SEP>A unit of storage such as a computer disk drive or computer sub-drive, about which volume information such as size, space consumed, and space available is collected.<SEP>A unit of storage such as computer disk drives and computer sub-drives, with size, consumed space, and available space information.

Query
A query received from a party concerning the archived data-stream, used to formulate responses based on analysis of stored management data.<SEP>A request received from a party concerning archived data-streams, answered by analyzing the management data stored in the database.<SEP>A query received from a party concerning the archived data-stream, used to formulate responses.<SEP>A search query in a first or second language that is segmented into tokens, annotated, translated, and searched against indexes.<SEP>A search request that is segmented into tokens, annotated with labels, and translated as part of the query pattern mining process.

Internet
The communication network identified in dependent claims as the network used for transmitting queries and responses.<SEP>The communication network over which queries and responses may be transmitted electronically.<SEP>A communication network over which queries and responses may be transmitted electronically.

Software Program
A program executed by a processor, causing the processor to perform data-stream archiving steps.<SEP>A program executed by a processor to perform steps including receiving data-streams and extracting management data.<SEP>A program contained on a storage medium that causes a processor to carry out actions.

Predetermined Rule Set
A rule set used to recognize distinct data sets of a data-stream, based on a data-stream protocol of a third party backup data product.<SEP>A rule set used to recognize distinct data sets of the data-stream, based on a data-stream protocol of a third party backup data product.

Third Party Backup Data Product
A backup data product whose data-stream protocol forms the basis of a predetermined rule set.<SEP>A backup product whose data-stream protocol forms the basis of a predetermined rule set used to recognize distinct data sets.<SEP>A product whose data-stream protocol forms the basis of a predetermined rule set.

Data File
Files within the data-stream whose types and keywords are identified as part of the management data.

File Folder
Folders that constitute distinct data sets separable from the data-stream during extraction.

Metadata
Metadata of the data of the data-stream, including user group identifiers, user access identifiers, file size, folder size, and author identifiers.<SEP>Metadata of the data-stream data including user group identifiers, user access identifiers, file size, folder size, and author identifiers.<SEP>Metadata of the data of the data-stream, including identifiers of user groups, identifiers of users having access, file size, folder size, and identifiers of authors.

Volume Information
Information concerning where data of the data-stream were stored, including volume size, space consumed, and space available.<SEP>Information concerning where the data of the data-stream were stored, including size of each volume, space consumed by each volume, and space available in each volume.

Source Identifier
An identifier of the source of the data-stream, included in the management data.

Data Type
Types of data within data sets such as text data, image data, audio data, graphic data, tabular data, hyperlink data, and executable data.

Protocol
A data-stream protocol adhered to by data-streams, which may be converted to a protocol supported by the backup storage device.

Indexing
A procedure of indexing types of data to obtain keywords thereof.

Party
A party that submits queries concerning archived data-streams and receives responses.<SEP>A user or administrator who submits queries concerning archived data-streams and receives responses based on the management data.

Data Files
Files within a data-stream whose types and keywords are part of the management data.<SEP>Files within the data-stream whose types and keywords are part of the management data.

Keywords
Keywords of the data files of the data-stream, obtained by indexing types of data.<SEP>Keywords of the data files of the data-stream.<SEP>Keywords of the data files of the data-stream, obtainable by indexing types of data.

Storage Medium
A storage medium referenced at the end of the input text.<SEP>A medium containing a software program capable of causing a processor to carry out data-stream archiving actions.

Storage Router Function
A function carried out between the sources and the backup storage device.

Data Sets
Distinct data sets separated from the data-stream, including file folders, data files, and types of data files.

Text Data
A type of data that may be segregated into data groups.

Image Data
A type of data that may be segregated into data groups.

Audio Data
A type of data that may be segregated into data groups.

Graphic Data
A type of data that may be segregated into data groups.

Tabular Data
A type of data that may be segregated into data groups.

Hyperlink Data
A type of data that may be segregated into data groups.

Executable Data
A type of data that may be segregated into data groups.

Data File Types
Information concerning the types of data files of the data-stream.

Server Function
A server function carried out between the sources and the backup storage device by the apparatus.

Method
A method comprising receiving a data-stream, storing it to a backup storage device, reading it out and extracting management data, and storing the management data in a searchable format in a database.

US8719408B2
A patent document titled "Automated digital media content filtration based on relationship monitoring" that describes methods and devices for filtering digital media content according to monitored user relationships.

Automated Digital Media Content Filtration
A method for automatically filtering digital media content based on relationship monitoring, involving establishing user relationships, monitoring interactions, identifying published content, determining relevancy weights, and presenting prioritized content to a user.

Content Producer
An entity that publishes digital media content and has an online association with a user, forming the basis of a monitored user relationship.<SEP>A producer of digital media content who has a user relationship with a user, monitored via online associations and profile compatibility.

User Relationship
A relationship established automatically according to a tolerance parameter, based on monitoring an online association between a user and a content producer.<SEP>A relationship between a user and a content producer established automatically according to a tolerance parameter, based on monitoring an online association, and possibly defined within a social networking internet site.

Tolerance Parameter
A parameter according to which a plurality of user relationships is automatically established.<SEP>A parameter according to which the relationship module automatically establishes user relationships.

Online Association
An online connection between a user and a content producer that is monitored to establish and maintain user relationships.<SEP>An online association between a user and a content producer that is monitored to establish user relationships.

Relationship Interaction
An interaction within a determined user relationship that is monitored and used to derive a strength factor.

Independent Server
One of a plurality of independent servers with which the system interacts as a third party to identify digital media content published by content producers.

Digital Media Content
Media content published by content producers, comprising at least one digital media content item, that is identified, weighted, and presented to the user.<SEP>Media content items published by content producers that are filtered, ranked, and presented to users based on relevancy weights.

Digital Media Content Item
An individual item of published digital media content for which a relevancy weight is determined.

Relevancy Weight
A weight determined for each published digital media content item, based on a strength factor, used to prioritize content presented to the user.<SEP>A weight assigned to each published digital media content item based on a strength factor derived from monitored relationship interactions, used for filtering, ranking, and prioritizing content.

Strength Factor
A factor derived from monitored relationship interactions between the user and the content producer, used as the basis for determining relevancy weight.<SEP>A factor derived at least in part from user-configurable weighing criteria and monitored relationship interactions, used to determine relevancy weights.

Media Aggregator
A component to which a set of published digital media content items is pushed based on relevancy weights and a user-configurable relevancy threshold.<SEP>A media aggregator to which sets of published digital media content items are pushed based on relevancy weights and a user-configurable relevancy threshold.

Media Aggregator Profile
A profile associated with the user that defines the media aggregator and the user-configurable relevancy threshold.

User-Configurable Relevancy Threshold
A user-configurable threshold used, together with relevancy weights, for pushing, filtering, or ranking digital media content items.<SEP>A user-configurable threshold used together with relevancy weights to filter or push sets of published digital media content items.

User Profile
A profile of the user that is compared with a content producer profile to detect profile compatibility.<SEP>A profile of the user used for detecting profile compatibility with a content producer profile.

Content Producer Profile
A profile of a content producer that is compared with a user profile to detect profile compatibility.<SEP>A profile of a content producer used for detecting profile compatibility with a user profile.

Profile Compatibility
Compatibility detected between a user profile and a content producer profile, used to modify the associated user relationship.<SEP>Compatibility between a user profile and a content producer profile, detected based at least in part on mutual interests, and used to modify the associated user relationship.

Mutual Interest
A shared interest between the user and a content producer, used at least in part to detect profile compatibility.

Social Networking Internet Site
An internet site within which a plurality of user relationships may be defined.

User-Configurable Weighing Criteria
Criteria from which the strength factor is derived at least in part.<SEP>Criteria configurable by the user from which the strength factor is derived at least in part.

Executable Program
A program stored on a computer-readable storage device that instructs a processor to perform the digital media content filtration steps.

data.entity_name: Apparatus For Automated Digital Media Content Filtration
data.content:
Apparatus For Automated Digital Media Content Filtration
An apparatus comprising a processor coupled to memory programmed to implement relationship, monitoring, detection, determination, and presentation modules for automated digital media content filtration based on relationship monitoring, as described in claim 17.

Relationship Module
A module configured to establish automatically, according to a tolerance parameter, a plurality of user relationships, each based on monitoring an online association between a user and a content producer.

Monitoring Module
A module configured to monitor determined user relationships for relationship interactions.

Detection Module
A module configured to interact with a plurality of independent servers as a third party to identify digital media content published by content producers having a user relationship with the user.

Determination Module
A module configured to determine a relevancy weight for each published digital media content item based on a strength factor derived from monitored relationship interactions.

Presentation Module
A module configured to present digital media content to the user such that content with greater relevancy weight receives higher priority.

Independent Servers
A plurality of independent servers with which the detection module interacts as a third party to identify published digital media content.

Relationship Interactions
Interactions of determined user relationships that are monitored by the monitoring module and used to derive strength factors.

Mutual Interests
One or more mutual interests between a user and a content producer used as a basis for detecting profile compatibility.

Translation-Based Query Pattern Mining
A technique for mining query patterns by translating annotated queries from a first language into a second language and extracting a translated query pattern from the aligned translated collection of queries.

Query Pattern
A pattern identifying a particular rule to interpret a particular type of query, expressed in a first language.<SEP>A rule identifying how to interpret a particular type of query, expressed in a first language and used to match queries in a query log.

Translated Query Pattern
A query pattern in a second language extracted from a translated collection of annotated queries, used to interpret and search for queries in the second language.<SEP>A query pattern extracted from a translated collection of queries in a second language, used to interpret received queries in the second language.

Query Log
A log of queries used to identify collections of queries matching a query pattern and to cross-validate translated query patterns against an occurrence threshold.<SEP>A collection of queries used to identify queries matching a query pattern and to cross-validate translated query patterns against a specified occurrence threshold.

First Language
The language in which the original query pattern and collection of queries are expressed.<SEP>The language in which the original query pattern and the collection of matching queries are expressed.

Second Language
The language into which the annotated queries are translated and in which the translated query pattern is extracted.<SEP>The language into which the annotated collection of queries is translated and in which the translated query pattern is extracted.

Query Component
A part of a query resulting from applying a translated query pattern to split a received query, used to search a respective index.

Index
A searchable index corresponding to a query component, searched using resulting query components.<SEP>A respective search index for each query component used to search for results responsive to a received query.

Search Results
Results responsive to a received query in the second language that are presented to a user.<SEP>Results responsive to a received query in the second language that are found using the translated query pattern and presented to a user.

Computer-Readable Medium
A medium with which the one or more processors interact in order to perform the described operations.

Occurrence Threshold
A specified threshold used when cross-validating a translated query pattern with a query log.<SEP>A specified threshold with respect to which a translated query pattern is cross-validated with a query log.

Query Components
Parts of a query resulting from splitting a received query using a translated query pattern, each used to search a respective index.

Non-Transitory Computer Storage Medium
A storage medium encoded with a computer program whose instructions cause data processing apparatus to perform query pattern translation operations.<SEP>A storage medium encoded with computer program instructions that, when executed by processors, cause a computer device to perform operations for determining factual entities and displaying knowledge panel content.<SEP>A computer storage medium encoded with computer program instructions that cause a computer device to perform operations for determining factual entities and displaying related content.

Data Processing Apparatus
Apparatus that executes program instructions to perform the query pattern translation operations.<SEP>An apparatus that performs the claimed method of receiving content, determining factual entities, requesting knowledge panel content, and providing display instructions.

Computing Devices
One or more devices forming a system that translates the collection of annotated queries.<SEP>One or more devices on or across which the stored program instructions are executed.

US10867122B1
A patent document titled "Contextually relevant knowledge panels in an application environment" that describes methods and systems for determining factual entities from document content and displaying knowledge panels with related content.

Knowledge Panel
A user interface element that provides a collection of content related to a factual entity, displayed contemporaneously with document content on a user device.

Factual Entity
An entity determined from document content that relates to the content, used to request and populate a knowledge panel.

Display Environment
An environment displayed on a user device into which a user types content, such as a document display environment displaying a document authored by the user.<SEP>A display area on the user device in which content is typed by a user; in some cases a document display environment displaying a document authored by the user.<SEP>A display environment that contains content and in which updated content is displayed via a user interface element.

User Device

Data Catalog

ETL Process

Source Data Object

Transformed Data Object
A data object generated by applying an ETL process to one or more source data objects.

History Object
An object created in a history data structure to specify information expected to be stored to describe the performance of an ETL process on a given source data object to generate a transformed data object.<SEP>An object created in a history data structure to specify information expected to be stored to describe the performance of the first ETL process on a given source data object to generate a transformed data object.

History Data Structure
A data structure in which instances of history objects are stored to maintain data lineage for data objects.<SEP>A data structure in which instances of history objects are stored to record information describing the performance of ETL processes.

Criteria
One or more conditions against which stored information describing the performance of an ETL process is evaluated to determine whether an event is triggered.<SEP>One of a plurality of different alternative criteria registered for triggering the event, evaluated against stored performance information to determine whether the event should be triggered.

Subscriber
An entity, such as an ETL process or another party, that subscribes to an event and receives notification or is caused to be performed when the event is triggered.<SEP>An entity, such as the second ETL process or another subscriber, that subscribes to an event and receives notification of the event.

Notification
A message sent to one or more subscribers for an event when the event is triggered.<SEP>A notification of the event sent to another subscriber different than the second ETL process when the performance of the first ETL process satisfies the criteria.

ETL Service
A service that performs both the first ETL process and the second ETL process.<SEP>A service that performs Extract, Transform, Load processes and provides a data catalog for monitoring ETL process performance and triggering subscribed events.

First ETL Process
An extract-transform-load process that is performed by the ETL service.<SEP>An Extract, Transform, Load process applied to one or more source data objects to generate one or more transformed data objects, whose performance is described by a history object instance.

Second ETL Process
A second extract-transform-load process that is also performed by the ETL service.<SEP>An Extract, Transform, Load process subscribed to an event that is triggered when the performance of the first ETL process satisfies criteria; it may be applied to the transformed data objects.

Third ETL Process
An Extract, Transform, Load process applied to one or more different source data objects to generate one or more different transformed data objects, whose performance is described by an instance of a second history object.

Fourth ETL Process
An Extract, Transform, Load process subscribed to a different event that is triggered when the performance of the third ETL process satisfies criteria.

Second History Object
An object created in the history data structure to specify information expected to be stored to describe the performance of the third ETL process.

Source Data Objects
Data objects to which the first ETL process is applied to generate transformed data objects.

Transformed Data Objects
Data objects generated by applying the first ETL process to source data objects.

Different Source Data Objects

Different Transformed Data Objects
Data objects generated by applying the third ETL process to different source data objects.

Different Event
An event registered for monitoring with regard to the second history object, triggered when the performance of the third ETL process satisfies criteria, and subscribed to by the fourth ETL process.

Non-Transitory Computer-Readable Storage Media
One or more non-transitory, computer-readable storage media referenced in claim 15 of a patent, containing instructions for performing ETL processes.<SEP>One or more storage media storing program instructions that when executed on computing devices implement the described ETL monitoring and event triggering operations.

data.entity_name: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance
data.content:
Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance
The title of patent US9589231B2, referring to a network-based approach for assisting diagnosis through similarity matching of medical cases and experts.

Diagnosis Assistance Method
A method that receives a query request including a new medical case, embeds the new case in an embedding space containing existing medical cases and experts, allows selection between query-for-cases and query-for-experts, and returns subsets based on computed similarity.

Embedding Space
A multidimensional space in which new medical cases, existing medical cases, and experts are represented.<SEP>A common multidimensional space in which new medical cases, existing medical cases, and experts are embedded so that similarity between their representations can be computed.

New Medical Case
A medical case submitted by a requester for which a diagnosis is sought, embedded in an embedding space.<SEP>A medical case submitted by a requester in a query request, comprising a plurality of records relating to a specific patient, which is embedded in the embedding space.

Existing Medical Cases
A set of previously known medical cases embedded in the embedding space and used for similarity comparison.<SEP>A set of previously stored medical cases embedded in the embedding space, used as candidates for similarity matching against a new medical case.

Experts
A set of experts embedded in the embedding space who can be queried and to whom a new case may be communicated for diagnosis.<SEP>A set of medical experts embedded in the embedding space based on information such as their profiles, coded medical procedures performed, authored articles, and linked stored medical cases.

Requester
A user who submits a query request including a new medical case and selects from query types.<SEP>A user who submits a query request including a new medical case and selects from available query types.

Query-For-Cases
A query type that returns a subset of existing cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and embedded existing cases.<SEP>A query type that, when selected, returns a subset of existing medical cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.

Query-For-Experts
A query type that returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and embedded experts.<SEP>A query type that, when selected, returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.

Query Cost
A computed cost for a query, differing between query-for-experts and query-for-cases.<SEP>A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts is different from and higher than the cost for a query-for-cases, encouraging requesters to try query-by-cases first.

Medical Ontology
A set of medical concepts joined by links, each concept corresponding to a dimension in the multidimensional representation, used as the basis for embedding medical cases and experts.

Unified Medical Language System
A medical ontology on which the embedding of medical cases and experts is based.

Matrix Of Proximities
A matrix applied to the multidimensional representation of the new case that accounts for relationships between concepts in the ontology when computing similarity measures.

Public Database
A database from which documents are returned, when query-for-cases is selected, based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and embedded documents.

Diagnosis
The determination sought for a new medical case, which an expert may attempt to provide.<SEP>The medical determination formulated by a selected expert to whom a new case is provided.

Patient Records
A plurality of records relating to a specific patient that make up the new medical case, including laboratory test results, images, symptom descriptions, patient monitor results, diagnoses, prescribed medications and treatments.

System For Diagnosis Assistance
A system comprising memory storing instructions for performing the diagnosis assistance method and a processor in communication with the memory for executing the instructions.

Computer Program Product
A product comprising a non-transitory recording medium storing instructions that, when executed on a computer, cause the computer to perform the diagnosis assistance method.

Computer Processor
A processor that performs at least one of the embedding, providing, returning subsets, and computing query cost steps of the method.

Diagnosis Assistance System
A system comprising memory and a processor that provides diagnosis assistance by handling queries and linking requesters and experts.

User Devices
A set of devices for linking requesters and experts with the diagnosis assistance system.

Multidimensional Representation
A representation generated in the embedding space for existing cases, experts, and a new case.

Query Type
A selectable option among a plurality of types including query-for-cases and query-for-experts.
